quarters.period: Three months ended Dec 31, 2025 (Q4, from the 10-K)

sections.title: Diluted earnings per share by quarter
sections.callout: Q4 2025: diluted EPS of $1.35, down from $1.43 a year earlier.

footnotes: Fourth quarters (Q4 2024, Q4 2025) have no 10-Q: they are the full year in the 10-K less the nine months in the third-quarter 10-Q.
Cash flow figures are reported year-to-date; each quarter is the year-to-date total less the previous quarter's.

Diluted EPS is not additive across quarters. Where the filing gives no three-month EPS (fourth quarters), it is calculated as net income to common ÷ estimated diluted shares (the full-year weighted average × 4 less the nine-month average × 3), and may differ from the reported figure by a cent or two.
Debt = long-term debt including the current portion; excludes leases.
The company reports no cost of revenue line, so net revenue flows straight to operating expenses.
The company reports no operating income line; pre-tax income is shown instead.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding. QoQ compares with Q3 2025; YoY with Q4 2024.

events.t: The Company also announced in the Press Release that its Board of Directors has declared a cash dividend of $0.45 per share on its Common Stock.

On January 6, 2026, American International Group, Inc. (the “Company”) announced that Chairman & CEO Peter Zaffino has notified the Company’s Board of Directors that he intends to transition to Executive Chair of the Company and retire as CEO by mid-year.

On December 10, 2025, the Board of Directors (the “Board”) of American International Group, Inc. (the “Company”) amended and restated the Company’s By-Laws (the “By-Laws”) following the Board’s annual review of its organizational documents.

American International Group, Inc. (NYSE: AIG) finalized the documentation relating to the previously disclosed agreement with John Neal regarding the mutual decision that he will no longer be joining the Company.

American International Group, Inc. (NYSE: AIG) today communicated that it has reached a mutual agreement with John Neal, who had been named to the position of President effective December 1, 2025, that he will no longer be joining the Company due to personal circumstances.
The Company also announced in the Press Release that its Board of Directors has declared a cash dividend of $0.45 per share on its Common Stock.

On March 10, 2026, James Dunne III notified the Board of Directors (“Board”) of American International Group, Inc. (the “Company”) of his decision not to stand for re-election at the Company's 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders, which is scheduled to occur on May 13, 2026 (the “2026 Annual Meeting”).
